title: Character Turnaround Sheets From Real AI Films
summary: 10 character turnaround sheets from real AI films, front, side and back, each with its exact prompt and a shot it fed. Copy the layout for your own.
body_markdown:
### What is a character turnaround sheet?


A character turnaround sheet is one image that shows a character from several fixed angles, usually the front, the side and the back, at the same scale on a plain background. Animators, game artists and AI filmmakers use it to draw or generate the same character in every shot.


### What views should a character turnaround include?


A turnaround should include at least the front, one side profile and the back, in a neutral pose. Many add a three-quarter view, the second profile or a large face close-up for dialogue shots.


### Is a turnaround the same as a model sheet or a character reference sheet?


The terms overlap. A turnaround is the set of angle views; a character reference sheet or model sheet is the whole page, which can add face close-ups, expressions, props and notes beside the turnaround.


### How do I make a character turnaround with AI?


Start from an image of the character, ask an image model for the front, side and back views side by side on a plain background in a neutral A-pose, and say that the face and costume must be identical in every panel.


### How do I use a turnaround sheet to keep an AI character consistent?


Attach the sheet as a reference image to every image and video prompt, name it in the prompt and say what it is for, such as "preserve her character sheet exactly". Add a line telling the model not to reproduce the sheet's labels or poses.


### Should a character turnaround sheet have labels?


Labels such as FRONT, LEFT and RIGHT help a person read the sheet, and some filmmakers ask for them. Others ask for no text, since a model can copy the labels into a shot; if you keep them, tell the shot prompt not to reproduce text.


### Can I make a turnaround sheet for an animal or a 2D character?


Yes. The same layout works for a dog, a cat or a flat 2D cartoon: describe the markings or the palette in words, keep the background plain and ask for every view to match.


### Is it free to make a character turnaround in Flick?


Yes, you can start free: a new account gets 100 credits at sign-up and 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and the image models that make turnaround sheets run on the Free plan. Video models that take reference images, such as Seedance 2.0, need the Standard plan.
